name: emphasis
description: Research-flavored status pills, brief cards, pill tables and agent-message styling for Claude Code replies

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: unicode: plain symbols any font draws; nerd-font: Nerd Font icons and rounded pill ends; none: no icons

boldColor.title: Bold color
boldColor.description: Color of bold lead labels such as **Cause:** (a theme key such as suggestion, a color name or hex); empty, the default, keeps the text color. Bold inside a sentence always keeps the text color.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: auto: follow the Claude Code theme (light themes get light colors; colorblind and ANSI themes get the theme's own colors); dark; light; theme: Claude Code's theme colors with solid chips
